description: Address review findings: unbounded chat loads, unvalidated $set payloads, N+1 user lookups, duplicate route, credits counter floor, and admin role escalation audit logging.
steps: Step 1: Replace Chat.find_all().to_list() in admin_dashboard.py and admin_analytics.py with MongoDB aggregation pipelines that sum message array lengths server-side.
Step 2: Add field allow-lists to settings, alerts, notifications, content, and syra endpoints that use raw $set.
Step 3: Batch user lookups in admin_conversations.py into a single $in query instead of N+1.
Step 4: Remove duplicate /alerts/unacknowledged-count route from admin_dashboard.py (keep in admin_alerts.py).
Step 5: Add a guard in admin_users.py credits endpoint to prevent monthly_message_count from going negative.
Step 6: Add audit logging when granting admin role in admin_users.py.
acceptance_criteria: No Chat.find_all().to_list() calls remain in dashboard or analytics
All $set update endpoints have field allow-lists
Conversations endpoint uses batch $in query for user lookups
Credits 'add' action cannot drive monthly_message_count below zero
Admin role grants write to audit_log collection
App boots and existing tests pass
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print(len(app.routes))'
Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_admin_endpoints.py -v
